show-openrouter.description: Show OpenRouter (only appears if a key file is present)

show-opencode.description: Show OpenCode Go (only appears if a key file is present)

show-mistral.description: Show Mistral (only appears if the Mistral CLI or Vibe is signed in)

help-text-stale.description: The percentages always come from the provider and are always measured against your real plan, even when the plan name on the card is out of date.

help-text-grey.description: A card that dims to grey is holding its last known figures because a check failed. It is not saying your usage stopped. Hover the ? on that card to see why and when the next attempt is.

help-text-plan.description: The plan name is read from your account once an hour. If the account cannot be reached it falls back to the sign-in file on this computer, which can lag a plan change by weeks. The ? says which one is in use.

help-text-claude-signin.description: Claude: open a terminal, type  claude  and press enter, then type  /login

help-text-chatgpt-signin.description: ChatGPT: open a terminal, type  codex login  and press enter

help-text-openrouter-signin.description: OpenRouter: this card reads a key file at  ~/.local/share/ai-usage-desklet/openrouter.env  and shows your account-wide credit. The per-key limit is a cap on that same balance, not a separate budget, so it is not shown as a bar.

help-text-opencode-signin.description: OpenCode Go: this card reads a key file at  ~/.local/share/ai-usage-desklet/opencode.env  and asks OpenCode's own usage endpoint, so it shows the same rolling, weekly and monthly percentages as the console, including usage made on your other devices. The plan is a flat monthly fee and the endpoint publishes no dollars, so there is no credits row.

help-text-mistral-signin.description: Mistral: this card reads the API key the Mistral CLI (vibe) stores in your desktop keyring at sign-in, and asks Mistral's billing endpoints for the monthly Vibe Code and API budgets. Sign in again with  vibe  in a terminal if the card says the sign-in has expired.

help-text-check.description: To check the poller by hand:  python3 ~/.local/share/ai-usage-desklet/poller.py --once --print

show-help.description: Show the ? marker on each card
